summary: This is an HDFC Bank 6-K filing reporting the outcome of a postal ballot (e-voting) on an unspecified resolution. The scrutiny report confirms the resolution passed with the requisite majority on April 26, 2026. The filing is a routine corporate governance disclosure under Indian company law and US SEC Form 6-K requirements. It does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spinoff, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The resolution's nature is not disclosed, but the filing is a procedural notice of voting results, not a special situation event.
